propositions: The target-side _is_at_level guard in _same_level_neighbors is not exercised by existing tests because all check_cycle_at_level tests use a single uniform level; a direct cross-level edge whose far end is source_id must be tested to pin this guard.

The state-is-None plus tombstone stub branch in _load_states_with_tombstones is unobservable when reduce returns None with a non-terminal recorded status, because without the stub _is_closed_after_batch's missing-dir fallback still closes the blocker.
A tombstone's status field overrides the reduced status, so an open blocker dir paired with a deleted-status tombstone counts as closed and unblocks the target.
A malformed tombstone degrades to deleted rather than absent, so an open blocker dir with unparseable tombstone bytes still counts as closed and unblocks the target.
